headline: Formal delimitation of admissible regions for biochemical state and parameter spaces
label: Admissible Biocircuit Parameter Spaces
summary: Three January 2026 preprints formalize admissibility in biochemical state spaces, biological process spaces, and biocircuit parameter regimes.
synthesis: Across three January 2026 preprints, the common thread is the explicit delimitation of regions in which biochemical models are admissible. One applies tropical algebra to bounded, absorbing biochemical state spaces, illustrated with cysteine redox regulation. A second proposes a locally convex, context-indexed mathematical space for biological processes, built on seminorm proximity, observation quotients, and irreversibility. The third introduces the Realizability Index (R-index) to quantify valid log-parameter regions for Michaelis-Menten and Hill kinetics. What is new is that admissibility is encoded explicitly, whether over state spaces or parameter spaces, rather than left implicit. The mathematical methods differ substantially, and the shared thread is conceptual; all three items are preprints.
